# AI Infrastructure / GPU Platform Engineer

> Runs the compute estate behind training and inference: GPU clusters, scheduling, high-speed networking, storage, reliability and capacity.

| AI Infrastructure & Platform | L1 Compute and hardware; also L3 Inference and ML platforms | Verified (V) | #7 of 24 | #8 of 24 · band A · Monte Carlo rank 7 (P10–P90 5–11) | D2 Platform & infrastructure |

## What you need

- **Must (headline):** Linux, Kubernetes, Networking, Terraform / IaC, Python (production), SRE (SLOs, on-call, incidents), Observability (OpenTelemetry traces, metrics).
- **Important (headline):** Git & CI/CD, Docker, AWS / Azure / GCP, GPU fleet ops & scheduling, System design, NCCL / RDMA / InfiniBand, Checkpointing & storage throughput, Hardware-fault reliability, Capacity & GPU/API cost governance.
- **Full inventory:** 59 skills (Must 7 · Important 17 · Should 22 · Optional 13), each with its evidence and posting keywords: [ai-infrastructure-engineer.md](../../03-skills-and-tech/inventories/ai-infrastructure-engineer.md).
- **Prerequisites:** Infrastructure depth; best feeders are SRE, DevOps and backend infrastructure engineers
- **Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills):** NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Generative AI LLMs (NCP-GENL) (Optional: inference-infrastructure roles); Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) (Optional: not in the corpus; common in platform hiring). Whether one is worth it: [credential ROI](../../04-certifications/credential-roi.md).
- What to learn first and what to drop across roles: [skills radar](../../03-skills-and-tech/skills-radar.md); in what order: [learning roadmaps](../../03-skills-and-tech/learning-roadmaps.md).

## How to prove it

- **What the evidence asks for:** A self-hosted cluster with continuous synthetic load, automated failover, autoscaling and dashboards, plus a written postmortem
- **Project archetypes that cover the most of its Must and Important skills** (Grade M): [P6 Self-hosted LLM platform on Kubernetes](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p6) (62%); [P1 Evaluated RAG system over a real corpus](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p1) (26%); [P20 Responsible-AI compliance packet with runtime guardrails](../../05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md#p20) (15%). One project rarely covers a role; [job-search strategy §2.6](../../06-job-search/job-search-strategy.md#26-the-constraints-that-bind-first) computes the smallest sets that do.
- How verifiable the proof must be, and what to publish: [proof-of-work standards](../../05-portfolio/proof-of-work-standards.md).

## How you are interviewed

- **Track: Infrastructure.** It tests KV-cache maths, decode roofline, continuous batching, prefill/decode disaggregation, GPU scheduling, p95 debugging. Source: career/02-roles/role-catalog.md §8.2 (T1-03, T0-14).
- **Practise:** the [infrastructure prep pack](../../08-interviewing/prep-packs.md#infrastructure-pack), plus the behavioural and coding packs.
- Classify the loop first, then prepare by round: [interview loops](../../08-interviewing/interview-loops.md).

## Résumé

- **Variant:** D2 (AI Systems & Infrastructure). Headline pattern: "Inference / AI Infrastructure Engineer | serving, GPUs, Kubernetes".
- **Keywords to mirror, only when true:** GPU, Kubernetes, infrastructure, distributed systems, NCCL, InfiniBand, SRE, Terraform (DevOps JDs: Kubernetes 69.4%, Terraform 59.1%, Linux 45.1%)
- **Leave out or reframe:** Listing SLURM or storage products you have not run (not named in the research corpus); generic DevOps bullets with no GPU scale
